SRC-251:R001.text: Permanently repair the Codex-to-SAIPEN operator-intent integration so authentic operator cc, continue and cc all resume canonically authorized work without the operator replaying PowerShell commands; an architectural correction, not another WAIT workaround

SRC-251:R002.text: Do not mutate AUDAPACK source, protocol history or recovery state; SAIPEN source changes need live SAIPEN execution admission; installing or changing hooks in CODEX_HOME is a separate host-configuration mutation that needs its own installation authority; the handoff authorizes bypassing neither gate

SRC-251:R003.text: Phase 0: verify the installed Codex version and the active CODEX_HOME, the supported hook schema, whether hooks are enabled and trusted, whether UserPromptSubmit and Stop fire in interactive sessions and in codex exec, and adapter compatibility; declare any mode that cannot deliver trusted operator input unsupported for automatic authorization

SRC-251:R004.text: Phase 1: a receipt production and verification boundary the agent cannot forge by writing files, setting environment variables or calling the hook directly, binding session, turn, canonical root, lineage, command digest, goal, expected checkpoint, uniqueness, expiry, atomic single use and verified host provenance; no signing secret exposed to agent commands; reject synthetic, replayed, expired, cross-lineage, cross-session, cross-project, duplicate and ambiguous receipts; state the same-user write-authority limit honestly

SRC-251:R005.text: Phase 2: extend the existing Codex adapter with UserPromptSubmit without breaking Stop and without a parallel adapter; an installer that is idempotent, version-aware, profile-aware for the real CODEX_HOME, reversible, non-destructive to user hooks, able to detect missing or disabled integration, and never copies .codex into .codex-account2 blindly

SRC-251:R006.text: Phase 3: recognize the explicit operator commands cc, continue and cc all, preserving the established goal, scope, budgets, ownership, checkpoint and safety restrictions; never read quoted examples, documentation, agent messages or tool output as operator commands; cc all never overrides NO_GO, STOP, FORENSICALLY_UNRECOVERABLE, recovery-only restrictions, cutover decisions, independent approvals or foreign ownership

SRC-251:R007.text: Phase 4: after authentic intent verification check identity, lineage, ownership, goal and admission, run only canonically authorized bounded recovery, revalidate and resume the original intent idempotently; an operator receipt and Work admission stay separate verified facts; never substitute a new goal
